focus: v4.0.2.0 Skilled in Your Project install/symlink/overlay flow run in check and plan modes against /tmp repos, plus sk-git commit-msg hook repros for v4.0.0.3 and v4.0.0.10
answeredQuestions: Does the Skilled in Your Project and vendored overlay flow from v4.0.2.0 (/doctor:install, /doctor:symlink, /doctor:overlay) hold up when read end to end and run only in check or plan modes, and which step would fail?

label: The /doctor:install ordered checklist ends on the read-only /doctor:git setup and never names /doctor:git standards init, so a freshly linked project installs git hooks whose commit-msg gate passes every message: running git commit -m 'added a file' in a fresh /tmp repo with core.hooksPath set to .skilled/scripts/git-hooks returned exit 0 and created the commit, because the hook treats a repository with no rules block as unchecked and never looks past skgit.contractDir and .sk-git/

Two contract resolutions disagree inside the Skilled checkout: the checkout has no .sk-git/ and no skgit.contractDir, so its own commit-msg hook enforces only the v4.0.0.10 Commit-Id trailer (repro blocked the message for the missing trailer, never for its invalid format), while validate-message.mjs --explain resolves .skilled/skills/sk-git/assets/ and reports the commit rules as enforced, and with a message on stdin it exits 0 printing no verdict at all

Two byte-identical copies of the git hook tree ship, .skilled/scripts/git-hooks and .opencode/scripts/git-hooks (diff -rq prints nothing), the live machine-wide hook points at the .skilled copy, every BLOCKED remediation string still names .opencode/scripts/install-git-hooks.sh, and /doctor:runtime-mirrors has no git-hooks parity check so the pair can drift with nothing to catch it; removing the duplicate breaks only the printed remediation strings

Sibling doctor engines use opposite exit-code conventions: overlay-engine status documents and returns 0 in sync, 1 out of sync, 2 failed precondition, while symlink-engine check on a repo with nothing installed prints 'missing core .skilled' and still exits 0, so a wrapper cannot key on the exit code; and symlink-engine plan emits no line at all for .skilled/specs when the project has no specs folder, while emitting 'link .skilled/specs -> ../specs' when it does

A repository with no .git/config skgit.contractDir and no .sk-git/ runs the commit-msg hook as a no-op that exits 0, so installing hooks without a contract is indistinguishable from installing nothing
symlink-engine plan creates .skilled/specs as a relative link to the project's own specs folder whenever that folder exists, and the entry is never printed when it does not

direction: symlink-engine.cjs ignores a project's specs folder because the file contains no literal 'specs'
reason: Ran plan against /tmp/dr6-spec.CPvWl1 with specs/001-x present and it printed 'link .skilled/specs -> ../specs'; the entry list is driven by the checkout's own .skilled/specs symlink, which the engine rewrites to a relative target, so a source-text grep proves nothing
